import numpy as np
from scipy import stats


def _fit(X, y, it=30):
    n = len(y)
    A = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), X]) if X.size else np.ones((n, 1))
    b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
    for _ in range(it):
        eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30)
        p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
        w = p * (1 - p) + 1e-9
        H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
        step = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - p))
        b += step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7:
            break
    p = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    return float(np.sum(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p)))


def design(feats):
    x = np.asarray(feats.x, float)
    y = np.asarray(feats.y, float)
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    p = len(ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([[s == l for s in feats.stratum] for l in labs[1:]]).astype(float) \
        if len(labs) > 1 else np.zeros((len(y), 0))
    R = np.abs(np.corrcoef(x, rowvar=False))
    alpha = 0.05 / p
    first = 0.5 / p
    sel = []

    def ll(cols, extra=None):
        parts = [S] + [x[:, cols]] + ([extra] if extra is not None else [])
        return _fit(np.column_stack(parts), y)

    base = ll(sel)
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        best, bj = None, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(R[j, k] >= 0.6 for k in sel):
                continue
            l = ll(sel + [j])
            if best is None or l > best:
                best, bj = l, j
        if bj is None or stats.chi2.sf(2 * (best - base), 1) > (alpha if sel else first):
            break
        sel.append(bj)
        base = best
    while len(sel) > 1:
        full = ll(sel)
        pv = [stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - ll([k for k in sel if k != j])), 1) for j in sel]
        if max(pv) <= alpha:
            break
        sel.pop(int(np.argmax(pv)))
    prods = []
    best, bp = None, None
    for a in range(p):
        for b in range(a + 1, p):
            if R[a, b] >= 0.6:
                continue
            m = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
            l0 = ll(m)
            l1 = ll(m, (x[:, a] * x[:, b])[:, None])
            st = 2 * (l1 - l0)
            if best is None or st > best:
                best, bp = st, (a, b)
    if bp is not None and stats.chi2.sf(best, 1) < 0.01 / (p * (p - 1) / 2):
        prods, pr = [bp], (x[:, bp[0]] * x[:, bp[1]])[:, None]
        full = ll(sel, pr)
        sel = [j for j in sel if j in bp or stats.chi2.sf(
            2 * (full - ll([k for k in sel if k != j], pr)), 1) <= alpha]
    drivers = [ids[j] for j in sel] + [ids[j] for ab in prods for j in ab if j not in sel]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in sel),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
